name: Vital Stats
description: Hunger, thirst, temperature, and stamina as four drains with consequences, not four progress bars. Each stat depletes on its own clock and crosses a threshold that routes damage through combat.damage_resolver — starvation is damage, freezing is damage, one death pipeline with many causes, so no parallel health system ever forks. Temperature is the odd one out: instead of a pure timer it samples world.weather_system and world.fire_warmth's warmth field every tick, because 'stand near the fire' must beat 'stand in the blizzard' through actual simulation rather than scripted safe zones. What REFILLS a stat — eating, drinking, resting — is the verb of whoever did it; this component owns only the drain and the consequence, which is what keeps food, beds, and campfires composable without VitalStats knowing any of them exist.

inputs.name: hungerDrainPerMinute
inputs.description: Hunger lost per game minute on a 0-100 scale. At the default, a full stomach lasts about an hour and a half of play — long enough to forget, short enough to plan around.

inputs.name: thirstDrainPerMinute
inputs.description: Thirst lost per game minute. Deliberately faster than hunger: the genre's settled instinct is that water is the early-game pressure and food the mid-game one.

inputs.name: staminaRegenPerSecond
inputs.description: Stamina recovered per second while not exerting. Exertion costs are charged by whoever exerts (sprint, chop, swim) against the staminaLevel output — this component only owns the recovery curve.

inputs.name: temperatureNeutral
inputs.description: Ambient temperature at which the temperature stat drifts toward full. Below it, the drain scales with the gap minus whatever warmth world.fire_warmth contributes at the player's position.

inputs.name: depletionDamagePerSecond
inputs.description: Damage routed to combat.damage_resolver per second per fully depleted stat. Multiple depleted stats stack, which is what makes ignoring two meters at once a death spiral instead of a lifestyle.

outputs.name: staminaLevel
outputs.description: Current stamina, 0 to 100. Exerting systems read and spend against this; it is the only stat designed to cycle within a single fight.

outputs.name: anyDepleted
outputs.description: True while at least one stat sits at zero and is dealing damage. The HUD's urgent state keys off this rather than four separate watchers.
